name: FISMA & Executive Order 14028 Federal Cybersecurity Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA - 44 U.S.C. § 3551) and Executive Order 14028 (Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity), covering FIPS 199 security categorization, Software Supply Chain Security (SBOM), zero-trust architecture, and Cyber Incident Reporting.

checklists.name: FISMA & EO 14028 Federal Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for FISMA 44 U.S.C. § 3554, NIST RMF, and EO 14028 section 4 requirements.

items.statement: FIPS 199 security categorization report defines system impact levels for Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability.
Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) in SPDX or CycloneDX format is generated automatically for every software build.
Secure Software Development Framework (NIST SP 800-218 SSDF) attestation form is signed by the software vendor.
Zero Trust Architecture deployment enforces microsegmentation and continuous identity verification.
CISA cyber incident reporting procedures guarantee notification within 8 hours for federal civilian agency systems.

reviewGates.name: FISMA Information Security Officer Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Federal Information Security Officer (ISO) confirms that FIPS 199 categorization, SBOMs, and SSDF attestations satisfy FISMA and EO 14028.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the federal cybersecurity audit evidence confirm compliance with FISMA and EO 14028 mandates?
